hero.title: Learn English from TED talks
hero.subtitle: Watch with a transcript that highlights each line as it is spoken and a Vietnamese translation under every line. Save new words, review them on a spaced schedule and take quizzes.
hero.invalidUrl: That link was not recognised. Paste a TED link like ted.com/talks/…
hero.youtubeBlocked: YouTube now blocks servers from downloading captions, so YouTube links are not supported. Please use a TED link.

preview.title: Transcript

one.en: So I want to start with a question.
one.vi: Tôi muốn bắt đầu bằng một câu hỏi.

two.en: What would you do with one extra hour a day?
two.vi: Bạn sẽ làm gì với thêm một giờ mỗi ngày?

three.en: Tap any line to jump the video there.
three.vi: Bấm vào một dòng để video nhảy tới đó.

preview.note: Interface illustration, not quoted from a real talk.

steps.title: Three steps to learn from a talk
steps.subtitle: Nothing to install, no account, works on your phone.

one.title: Pick a talk
one.body: Paste a link to a talk on ted.com, or choose one of the sample talks below.

two.title: Listen and read
two.body: The line being spoken lights up with the video, the Vietnamese translation right under it. Tap a line and the video jumps there.

three.title: Save words and review
three.body: New words become cards with the original line. Save them to your word book, review on a spaced schedule and take quizzes.

try.title: Start with a sample talk
try.subtitle: Each one has a Vietnamese translation by the TED community. Shortest first.

features.title: Everything to learn from one talk

sync.title: The spoken line lights up
sync.body: The transcript follows the video. Tap a line to seek right to it; scroll ahead on your own and it will not drag you back.

bilingual.title: Bilingual, line by line
bilingual.body: The TED community’s Vietnamese translation sits right under each English line. One button turns it on or off.

search.title: Search what was said
search.body: Type a word to see every time it comes up, in the translation too.

export.title: Export to a file
export.body: TXT, SRT, VTT or Markdown, with the translation if you like.

cards.title: Cards with the original line
cards.body: Words and phrases worth learning come straight from the talk, each card with the exact line and timestamp.

book.title: Your own word book
book.body: Keep only the words you want to remember. Write meanings and examples your own way.

srs.title: Spaced review
srs.body: Each word comes back just as you are about to forget it, based on how well you knew it last time.

quiz.title: Four kinds of quiz
quiz.body: Fill in the original line, meaning to word, word to meaning, and typing the word. Retry only what you missed.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. Every feature is free, with no paid plan. There are only abuse limits, such as not opening too many different talks within a few minutes.
faq.q2: Where is my study data kept?
faq.a2: Your word book, review progress and quiz results stay in your browser. There are no accounts yet, so nothing syncs between devices, and clearing browser data erases it.
faq.q3: Where do word meanings come from?
faq.a3: Every card has the word and its real line from the talk. You write the Vietnamese meaning yourself, right on the card, with your own example.
faq.a4: No. Videos stream directly from TED’s servers and are never downloaded or stored. The site keeps only transcripts and talk details.
faq.a5: YouTube blocks fetching captions from a server without its own anti-bot token. We chose not to work around that, so only TED is supported for now.
faq.q6: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a6: Yes. The video stays pinned at the top, the transcript scrolls underneath, and every button is big enough to tap.

errors.title: Could not get the transcript
errors.INVALID_URL: That link is not valid. Check it and paste a TED URL.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE: That source is not supported yet. TED only for now.
errors.YOUTUBE_BLOCKED: YouTube blocks servers from downloading captions, so YouTube links are not supported. Please use a TED link.
errors.VIDEO_UNAVAILABLE: This talk does not exist or has been removed.
errors.VIDEO_PRIVATE: This talk is not public, so its transcript cannot be read.
errors.AGE_RESTRICTED: This content is restricted, so its transcript cannot be read.
errors.LIVE_STREAM: This is a live broadcast. Wait until it ends and try again.
errors.NO_CAPTIONS: This talk has no transcript on TED yet.
errors.CAPTIONS_EMPTY: The source returned an empty transcript for this talk.
errors.UPSTREAM_BLOCKED: TED is blocking requests from the server. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.UPSTREAM_FAILED: Could not reach TED. Try again shortly.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many talks at once. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.INTERNAL: Something unexpected broke. Please try again.

vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.subtitle: Pulled from the transcript. Every card traces back to the line it came from.
vocab.empty: No vocabulary could be extracted from this transcript.
vocab.attribution: Source: {title} on TED, licensed CC BY-NC-ND.
vocab.rateHint: Flip the card, then rate how well you remembered it.
vocab.shortcutsSrs: Shortcuts: Space flips · ← → navigate · 1–4 rate · S save/unsave
vocab.singleSense: This word has only one common sense.

no-key.title: No automatic meanings
no-key.body: AI meanings are not switched on here. Every card still has the word and the real line from the talk. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning". Tap ☆ to save a word to your word book and review it.
no-key.devHint: The extraction and the source phrases are real, taken straight from the transcript. Meanings, IPA and the B1–B2 / C1+ split need a model. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to .env.local and restart the dev server. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".

auth.title: Automatic meanings are unavailable for now
auth.body: The AI meaning service has a problem. Every card still has the word and the real line from the talk. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".
auth.devHint: The API rejected the key in .env.local (401): it may have been deleted, revoked or pasted incompletely. Reloading will not fix this. Create a new key on console.anthropic.com, put it in .env.local and restart the dev server. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".

billing.title: Automatic meanings are unavailable for now
billing.body: The AI meaning service is paused. Every card still has the word and the real line from the talk. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".
billing.devTitle: The Anthropic account is out of credit
billing.devHint: The key is valid, but the API refused because there is no credit left. Add credit under Plans & Billing on console.anthropic.com, then reload. For now the cards keep their source lines but have no meanings. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".

failed.title: Could not get automatic meanings
failed.body: This lookup did not succeed. Reload the page to try again. Meanwhile every card still has its line from the talk, and you can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".
failed.devTitle: Could not get meanings from the model
failed.devHint: This model call did not succeed, so the cards show source lines only for now. Reload to try again; if it keeps failing, check the dev server log. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".

limited.title: Automatic meanings paused
limited.body: You looked up automatic meanings for many talks in a short time, so this one waits for now. Every card still has the word and the real line from the talk. You can write meanings yourself: flip a card and choose "Write a meaning".
limited.devHint: mayUseModel() in lib/limits/guard.ts refused: this IP used up MODEL_LIMIT (talks allowed to call the model per hour). Counted in memory; restarting the dev server clears it.

note.empty: No notes on this card yet.

note.hintMore: Tip: add the word’s other common meanings to remember it better.
note.adoptHint: Or pick one of Claude’s meanings as the one used in the talk:

errors.adoptFull: Your notes already hold {max} meanings — remove one first.

vocab.saveHint: Save this word to review it on a spaced-repetition schedule.

review.title: Today's review
review.subtitle: Due cards from every talk you have studied, scheduled with spaced repetition.
review.newCap: Up to {count} new cards a day
review.noCardsBody: Save words to your word book from a talk’s Vocabulary page — only saved words are reviewed.
review.localOnly: Progress is saved in this browser only. Clearing site data erases it; syncing across devices comes with accounts.

wordBook.title: Word book
wordBook.subtitle: Words you saved from talks, reviewed on a spaced-repetition schedule.
wordBook.emptyBody: Open the Vocabulary page of a talk and tap ☆ Save to word book on the words you want to remember.
wordBook.removed: Removed “{word}”. Its review progress is kept if you save it again.
wordBook.localOnly: Your word book is stored in this browser. Clearing site data erases it; syncing across devices comes with accounts.

notice.title: You now choose what goes in your word book
notice.body: Opening a Vocabulary page used to put every word of the talk on your review schedule. Now only words you save with ☆ are reviewed. {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} added that way but never reviewed were taken out; words you already reviewed stay in the book with their progress. To review one again, open its talk’s Vocabulary page and tap Save.

quiz.title: Vocabulary quiz
quiz.intro: Extra practice that does not change your review schedule. Every question comes from the speaker’s own line and the meanings you already have.

cloze.label: Fill in the line
cloze.hint: Pick the word the speaker said. Works for every word.

meaningToWord.label: Meaning → word
meaningToWord.hint: See the meaning, pick the English word. Needs a meaning.

wordToMeaning.label: Word → meaning
wordToMeaning.hint: See the word, pick its meaning. Needs a meaning.

typing.label: Type the word
typing.hint: See the meaning, type the English word. Needs a meaning.

quiz.withoutMeaning: {count, plural, one {# word has} other {# words have}} no meaning yet, so only fill-in-the-line is asked for them.
quiz.notEnough: Not enough words for the chosen types. Multiple choice needs at least 4 words; meaning questions need words with a meaning.

ask.cloze: Which word did the speaker say in the gap?
ask.typing: Type the English word with this meaning:

quiz.retryWrong: Retry {count, plural, one {# missed question} other {# missed questions}}
quiz.saveWrong: Save {count, plural, one {# missed word} other {# missed words}} to the word book
